name: Cenn Febrat

attributes.attribute: a variant spelling of Cenn Abrat

text: Cenn Febrat is a variant spelling of Cenn Abrat, a place tied to legend in early Ireland. There Lugaid mac Con went down to defeat before the southern forces of the Eóganacht, led by his own brother Eógan.

okr.objective: Record Cenn Febrat as a variant spelling of Cenn Abrat.
key_results: Cenn Febrat spells Cenn Abrat in a variant form.
Cenn Abrat saw the legendary defeat of Lugaid mac Con by Eógan.
